description: MOVI (*multi-objective value iteration*) plans when each action has a vector of costs, for example time and risk. A value is then a set of cost vectors: the *convex coverage set*, one vector for each policy that is best for some weighting of the objectives. MOVI sweeps every reachable state until no set moves by more than ε. A sum above the bound `b` becomes `b`, which keeps out *improper* policies (policies that may never reach a goal). It returns one deterministic proper policy per vertex of the start state's set and is the exact reference for small problems.

papers.authors: Dillon Z. Chen, Felipe Trevizan, Sylvie Thiébaux
papers.title: Heuristic Search for Multi-Objective Probabilistic Planning
